content: Shake the vial again for 30 seconds and allow the contents to settle for 2 to 3 minutes. Repeat this process as needed until the contents of the vial are completely dissolved. After reconstitution, each vial contains 100 mg/20 mL (5 mg/mL) of remdesivir solution. Parenteral drug products should be visually inspected for particulate matter and discoloration prior to administration, whenever the solution and container allow. Once reconstituted, the total storage time before administration should not exceed 4 hours at room temperature or 24 hours if refrigerated at 2°C to 8°C. During the dilution process, care must be taken to prevent accidental microbial contamination. Since this product does not contain any preservatives or bacteriostatic agents, aseptic technique must be used when preparing the final parenteral solution. It is always recommended to administer intravenous medications immediately after preparation whenever possible. Following reconstitution as instructed, each vial will contain a 100 mg/20 mL (5 mg/mL) remdesivir concentrated solution. For pediatric dosing, an appropriately sized syringe (e.g., 25, 50, or 100 mL) should be used to withdraw the required volume of reconstituted solution containing remdesivir for injection. A syringe may also be used for delivering volumes less than 50 mL. Withdraw the required volume of reconstituted remdesivir solution and inject it into a 0.9% sodium chloride infusion bag. Gently invert the bag 20 times to mix the solution thoroughly. Do not shake the bag. The prepared diluted solution is stable for 4 hours at room temperature (20°C to 25°C) or 24 hours in the refrigerator (2°C to 8°C), including any time before dilution into intravenous infusion fluids. The prepared diluted solution should not be administered simultaneously with any other medication. Administer the diluted solution at the infusion rate specified in the instructions. The infusion rate may be adjusted based on the total volume to be infused. For storage of prepared dosages, reconstituted vials can be stored for up to 4 hours at room temperature (20°C to 25°C) or 24 hours at refrigerated temperature (2°C to 8°C) prior to administration. Dilution should occur on the same day as administration. Before dilution, equilibrate remdesivir injection to room temperature (20°C to 25°C). Sealed vials can be stored for up to 12 hours at room temperature prior to dilution. Store the diluted remdesivir solution for infusion for up to 4 hours at room temperature (20°C to 25°C) or 24 hours at refrigerated temperature (2°C to 8°C). It is important to note that this product contains no preservatives. Any unused portion of a single-dose remdesivir vial should be discarded after a diluted solution is prepared. Maintain adequate records documenting the receipt, use, and disposal of remdesivir. Patients receiving remdesivir should undergo appropriate clinical and laboratory monitoring to facilitate the early detection of any potential adverse events, given the limited experience with remdesivir at the recommended dose and duration. Additionally, completion of the FDA MedWatch Form to report all medication errors and serious adverse events is mandatory. For mandatory reporting requirements, refer to the section on Mandatory Requirements for Remdesivir Administration Under Emergency Use Authorization.
